name: DeepSeek Credit
description: Shows your remaining DeepSeek credit in Orca's status bar. Czech and English. Only sends a balance request to api.deepseek.com.

cover.alt: DeepSeek Credit for Orca: remaining DeepSeek credit in the status bar, by Hanys

settings.title: DeepSeek API key
settings.description: Key from platform.deepseek.com/api_keys. Sent only to api.deepseek.com.

settings.title: Refresh interval (minutes)
settings.description: How often the credit is reloaded.

settings.title: Language
settings.description: Language of the status bar text. Auto follows your system language (Czech or Slovak gives Czech, anything else English).
